overview: G.R.O.W (Global Resources for Online Wisdom) is a cyberpunk-themed AI-powered academic productivity ecosystem where students buy, sell, and exchange academic notes. Features Internet Identity login, real file storage for PDFs and images, an AI Note Quality Analyzer that auto-scores uploads and detects duplicates, and a comprehensive admin dashboard with moderation tools, analytics charts, and reporting.
features: Cyberpunk dark space theme with neon accents and animated backgrounds
Internet Identity authentication with role-based admin access
PDF and image note uploads with persistent backend storage
AI Note Quality Analyzer: auto-scores 0-100, detects duplicates, suggests titles and tags
Enhanced admin dashboard with charts, moderation, user management, bulk export
Credits system with upload-to-earn and leaderboard
Live upload feed, webinars, subjects preview pages
SPA navigation with browser history support
G.R.O.W Assistant AI bot for tutorials and guidance
Web Audio API synthesized sound effects
